abstract_sentences.text: Neural scaling laws underlie many of the recent advances in deep learning, yet their theoretical understanding remains largely confined to linear models.

evidence.anchor: “theoretical understanding remains largely confined to linear models”

abstract_sentences.text: In this work, we present a systematic analysis of scaling laws for quadratic and diagonal neural networks in the feature learning regime.

evidence.anchor: “systematic analysis of scaling laws for quadratic and diagonal neural networks”

abstract_sentences.text: Leveraging connections with matrix compressed sensing and LASSO, we derive a detailed phase diagram for the scaling exponents of the excess risk as a function of sample complexity and weight decay.

evidence.anchor: “connections with matrix compressed sensing and LASSO”

abstract_sentences.text: This analysis uncovers crossovers between distinct scaling regimes and plateau behaviors, mirroring phenomena widely reported in the empirical neural scaling literature.

evidence.anchor: “crossovers between distinct scaling regimes and plateau behaviors”

abstract_sentences.text: Furthermore, we establish a precise link between these regimes and the spectral properties of the trained network weights, which we characterize in detail.

evidence.anchor: “precise link between these regimes and the spectral properties”

abstract_sentences.text: As a consequence, we provide a theoretical validation of recent empirical observations connecting the emergence of power-law tails in the weight spectrum with network generalization performance, yielding an interpretation from first principles.

introduction_moves.move: context → 将训练数据、模型规模和计算量的联合扩展视为 generalization bottleneck 的核心背景；下一段把背景落到可优化对象。
problem → 给出带 ℓ2 weight decay 的两层 ERM（式 (1)），明确 W、a、激活函数和目标是 ERM minimizer 的 excess risk；下一段指出既有理论边界。

evidence.anchor: 式 (1) 与 “supervised empirical risk minimization”

introduction_moves.move: failure_of_prior_work → 指出 scaling-law 理解主要停留在 random-features/kernel 的 lazy regime；问题转为 genuine feature learning。

evidence.anchor: “remains largely confined to the random features regime”

introduction_moves.move: method_preview → 建立 teacher–student 生成式设定（式 (2)）和 excess-risk 目标（式 (3)），随后限定两类可精确分析的浅层网络。

evidence.anchor: “teacher network of the same architecture” 与式 (2)-(3)

introduction_moves.move: core_idea → 先把 diagonal network 映射为 LASSO（式 (4)-(5)），再把 quadratic network 映射为 PSD nuclear-norm matrix sensing（式 (6)-(7)）；AMP/SE 成为共同分析桥梁。

evidence.anchor: “equivalent to the LASSO problem” 与 “matrix compressed sensing”

introduction_moves.move: missing_insight → 用 power-law/quasi-sparse target（式 (8)-(9)）连接可学习特征数、噪声 bulk 与 spectral tail；下一段列出四项可核对结果。

evidence.anchor: “coefficients decay according to a heavy-tailed distribution”

introduction_moves.move: contribution_list → 四项主张依次覆盖 noisy phase diagram/optimality、learned spectrum、谱–泛化分解、以及超出 proportional asymptotics 的 SE 数值有效性；第 4 项同时承认证明缺口。
scope_boundary → 以 “simple network models” 收束主线，再转入按 scaling laws、spectra、AMP/SE、compressed sensing 组织的相关工作。

evidence.anchor: “comprehensive theoretical and empirical understanding ... simple network models”

related_work_moves.move: taxonomy → 按 lazy scaling（kernel、random features、NTK）与 trained linear networks 划分；缺口落在 beyond linear/lazy 的 genuine feature learning。

nearest_neighbor_contrast → 对比 Ren et al. 与 Ben Arous et al.：二者用 sublinear width、orthogonal first-layer、power-law second-layer，本文改用 ERM + weight decay + noisy targets，并区别 information exponent 与 SGD dynamics。
taxonomy → spectral literature 从 empirical heavy-tailed eigenvalues、few-step dynamics 到 mean-field convergence；本文定位为 trained-weight spectrum 的 analytic characterization。

evidence.anchor: “precise theoretical characterization of the learned spectra ... remains elusive”

related_work_moves.move: limitation_of_prior → AMP/SE 既有保证依赖 fixed n/d 与 fixed λ；本文明确将 SE 超出 proven regime 的使用标成 heuristic，并以实验支撑。
credit_or_foundation → compressed-sensing 工作提供 quasi-sparse ℓp minimax 基础；本文声称扩展到全 regularization/data-scale phase diagram，而非重新包装 kernel 结果。

evidence.anchor: “full phase diagram across all regularization strengths and data scales”

method_moves.move: setup_notation → 式 (1) 定义两层 ERM，式 (2)-(3) 固定 Gaussian covariates、Gaussian label noise、teacher–student target 和 test excess risk。
define_component → diagonal network（p=d、W=diag(w)、linear、b=0）通过 θ_i=a_iw_i/√d 形成 effective linear predictor，并等价为 LASSO（式 (4)-(5)）。
define_component → centered quadratic network 用 S=WᵀW/√(pd) 和 Z=(xxᵀ−I_d)/√d 写成 Tr[SZ]，固定模型二层权重为 all-one，训练变为 PSD trace/nuclear-norm matrix sensing（式 (6)-(7)）。

evidence.section: Quadratic neural network and matrix compressed sensing

method_moves.move: setup_notation → target 权重按 θ_i*~N(0,d i^−2γ) 或 rotationally invariant S* 的 √d i^−γ eigenvalues 构造，γ>1/2 保证 square-summability（式 (8)-(9)）。
derive → Appendix A.1 用 AM–GM 给出 ℓ2 factorization 的 ℓ1 下界，再用 u_i=sign(θ_i)|θ_i|^{1/2}, w_i=|θ_i|^{1/2} 达到 tightness，闭合 diagonal→LASSO 等价（式 (21)-(22)）。

evidence.anchor: “Step 1. Lower bound via AM–GM” 与 “Step 2. Tightness”

method_moves.move: derive → Appendix A.2 说明 centering 只移除 constant offset，W 的 Frobenius penalty 诱导 tr(S)，并以 matching-covariance GOE measurements 做 matrix-sensing universality replacement。

evidence.anchor: “weight decay on W induces a trace penalty on S”

method_moves.move: instantiate_algorithm → GAMP 迭代（式 (30)-(32)）与 proximal denoisers（式 (33)-(36)）把凸 ERM 固定点接到 state evolution；Theorem 1 追踪 overlaps 与 risk。
connect_to_prediction → LASSO soft-thresholding（式 (42)）产生 effective noise δ 与 cutoff ε，最终风险由 ν 的 self-consistent equation（式 (46)-(49)）确定。
connect_to_experiment → quadratic SE 在有限 d 用 M=√q̂ Z+m̂S* 的 eigendecomposition、spectral denoiser 和 Monte Carlo overlaps 数值化（式 (218)-(219)）。

evidence.anchor: “we resorted to computing the integral J by a Monte-Carlo procedure”

result_inventory.claim: Noisy excess-risk phase diagram is universal after n_eff reparameterization.
result_inventory.value: Result 1: plateau Θ(1); fast/minimax Θ(n_eff^(−1+1/(2γ))) plus ρ(n_eff/d); interpolation Θ(λ^−2/3); large-sample Θ(d/n_eff); regularized branches Θ((λd^1/2/n_eff)^(2−1/γ)) and Θ(λ²d²/n_eff²).
result_inventory.comparison: diagonal n_eff=n vs quadratic n_eff=n/d; ρ(t)=−1/log t vs t^(2/5); first diagonal branch has logarithmic correction in Appendix C.2.
result_inventory.statistical_method: AMP/SE deterministic equivalent; Θ scaling, no interval or test.

result_inventory.claim: Risk is non-monotone around interpolation under weak regularization.
result_inventory.value: For n_eff≈d and λ→0+, peak R≈λ^−2/3; crossover n_eff^cross is (log d)^((4γ−1)/(2γ−1)) for diagonal and d^(4γ/(14γ−5)) for quadratic.
result_inventory.comparison: Phase IV decreases before interpolation, Phase V grows from noise bulk, VIa/VIb decrease after interpolation.
result_inventory.statistical_method: asymptotic order analysis plus simulation curves.

result_inventory.comparison: regularized ERM vs Bayes risk; diagonal rate carries stated logarithmic factors.
result_inventory.statistical_method: minimization of Result 1 orders and comparison to Bayes fixed point.

claim_closure.claim: 两种 feature-learning shallow networks 的 noisy scaling-law phase diagram。
claim_closure.method_response: 式 (4)-(7) 将网络训练化为 LASSO/matrix sensing；式 (10) 统一 n_eff。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Result 1、Figure 1、Figure 3 与 Appendix C/D phase derivations 给出直接数值和结构回应；non-asymptotic 部分仍依赖 conjecture。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: Conclusion 重述 universal phase diagram 与 mapping；没有新增 rate。

claim_closure.method_response: AMP fixed point 给出 soft threshold / shifted spectral measure。
claim_closure.evidence_response: Result 2、Figure 2、Figures 6–7、Appendix C.1.2/D.1-D.5 覆盖 bulk、spike、outlier 与 bleed-out；架构范围有限。
claim_closure.conclusion_response: 结论将 under/over/approximation errors 回收为 distinct spectral features。

evidence.anchor: 八个 phase 的文字解释

claim_closure.claim: 谱统计与 generalization 的 first-principles connection。
claim_closure.method_response: 式 (17)-(18) 对 quadratic network 给出 universal error decomposition，Appendix C 给出 diagonal analogue。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 论文把带 weight decay 的两层 diagonal/quadratic feature learning ERM 映射为 LASSO 与 PSD matrix sensing，以 AMP/state evolution 推出统一 n_eff 的 risk phase diagram；再用 soft-thresholded spectrum 将 bulk、spikes、outliers 一一解释为 overfitting、underfitting 与 approximation error，最后以有限维曲线支持该机制。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 主文保留 ERM/teacher–student 定义、两种 exact model reductions、power-law target、Result 1–3、Figure 1–3、non-asymptotic caveat 与结论；这些对象承担选择 phase、正则化和谱–泛化解释的决策作用。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: AM–GM tightness、GOE universality、GAMP/SE fixed points、逐相位展开、Bayes risk、BBP perturbation、Result 3 代数、ridge proof 和 LBFGS/Monte Carlo 实现均移到 p15–42；主文仍可读懂结果，但复核常数、对角 log factors 与 finite-d procedure 必须进入附录。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 最有效模式是先用两个 exact reductions 固定共同分析对象，再用 n_eff 把两架构放到同一 phase diagram，并把每个 risk term 绑定到可观测 spectrum component；Figure 1 的相图、Figure 2 的谱 overlay、Figure 3 的 risk overlay 形成由机制到证据的短链。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 最大的未闭合点是把 proportional-limit AMP/SE 延伸到任意 n,d,λ 的 non-asymptotic claim：Conjecture 1/2 有曲线支持却没有 multiplicative proof；此外 quadratic 结果使用 sub-extensive-rank BBP simplification，实验没有 seed/uncertainty 报告，也没有 component ablation。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 若论文提出 scaling law，同时给出一个可测的结构量分解误差，并让相图、结构图和 finite-size curve 对齐同一组 phase transitions，读者能把幂律结果转换成机制判断。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有 exact reduction、可写 state evolution、可控制目标谱的 convex/global-ERM 问题；对一般深层非凸训练、SGD trajectory、非 Gaussian/correlated data 或无法观测权重谱的系统，不能把相同闭环外推为定理。
